verdict.rationale: TaxJar's API requires an 'x-api-version' header, indicating some form of API versioning exists, but there is no documented deprecation policy, changelog, or sunset timeline evidenced anywhere in the pack. Probes for OpenAPI spec and llms.txt both failed (404), further limiting machine-readable API contract discovery for AI-native tooling. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, changelog of version changes, OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, and any evidence of long-term version support commitments.
